name: FUN_RAPID_DEFAULT_ACCOUNTS
description: Stores the input xml files for Rapid Start

columns.name: DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Unique sequence identifier for the generated account for defaulting into the accounting specifications included in the setup objects of various Fusion Financials products.

columns.name: DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the generated account for defaulting into the accounting specifications included in the setup objects of various Fusion Financials products.

columns.name: CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS_ID
columns.description: Accounting key flexfield structure instance identifier.

columns.name: NATURAL_ACCOUNT_SEGMENT_VALUE
columns.description: Account value for the natural account segment of the generated account code combination.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Account code combination identifier of the generated account.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
